description:
Cast the copy of Vicious Verse by paying {B/R}.
Displacer Kitten and Electro both trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking and re-preparing Whiplash Wordsmith.
Resolve the copy of Vicious Verse, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat.
